summary: The PDF supports 162 analyzed people in Experiment 1 and 299 people contributing 329 works in Experiment 2, so eligibility holds. No count errors were found; randomized totals and arm sizes remain unconfirmed, sample overlap is unstated, and the online appendices could not be accessed.
